text:
Aisha (Eng): Hey all — accepted the org invite and SSO earlier, but when I try to push to repo `redwood-inference/infrastructure` I get a 403. Not sure who to ping for repo write access?
Sam (Platform): @Aisha can you paste the exact error you see and whether you can see the repo in the web UI? quick check: `gh auth status` and `git remote -v` might help.
Aisha (Eng): here's the push output:
```
remote: Permission to redwood-inference/infrastructure.git denied to aisha.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
I can see the repo in the org, but the "Code" button gives 404 when I click clone (I think because web UI shows limited files?).
Devon (Infra): Two typical causes: org SSO not fully provisioned or you're not yet in the infra-core team. Maria, did People Ops finish the SSO push for Aisha?
Maria (People Ops): I approved the initial invite and triggered SSO, but the 2FA flag came back as off for this account. GH requires orgs to enforce 2FA — did you enable it under https://github.com/settings/security?
Aisha (Eng): Ah I didn't realize 2FA was required. I thought SSO acceptance did it automatically. I just enabled TOTP and SMS backup codes.
Sam (Platform): Cool — after enabling, sign out of GH CLI and sign back in: `gh auth login` then `gh auth status`. Also try `curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -u aisha https://api.github.com/user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference` to confirm membership (you'll get a 200 and role). If still 403, ping `@devon` here and I'll ask infra to add infra-core.
Devon (Infra): I checked the org teams — Aisha wasn't in infra-core. I just added you to `infra-core` and gave repo write on `infrastructure`. Give GitHub ~30s to apply team mapping, then try again.
Aisha (Eng): re-trying now... `git push` succeeded, and I can see the repo tree in the web UI. Thanks Sam + Devon! :tada:
deploy-bot: note: user membership change detected for aisha — added to team infra-core (audit id: 9f3b2c).
Aisha (Eng): closing the loop — all good. If anyone wants to confirm any onboarding steps I missed, happy to share checklist feedback. :thumbsup:
